device_entry.name: Robo HAT MM1 电机控制板
tags: 移动机器人与自动驾驶实验
device_entry.description: 用于机器人与无人小车实验的车载控制板。该组件通过串口读取来自 SAMD51 的 RC/PWM 控制信号，并将其映射为归一化的转向与油门输出，适合 DonkeyCar 类平台的人为遥控与自动驾驶控制流程。
device_entry.description_en: An onboard control board for robotics and autonomous RC car experiments. It reads RC/PWM control signals from a SAMD51 over serial and maps them to normalized steering and throttle outputs, suitable for DonkeyCar-like user-control and autonomous driving workflows.

schema.description: 关闭控制器并停止相关通信。
schema.description_en: Shut down the controller and stop related communication.

schema.description: 从串口读取转向和油门控制信号，并映射为归一化输出。
schema.description_en: Read steering and throttle control signals from serial and map them to normalized outputs.

schema.description: 启动或执行持续更新流程，循环读取串口输入，并在启动时加入延时以避免异常。
schema.description_en: Start or execute the continuous update loop, repeatedly reading serial input with a startup delay to avoid errors.

schema.description: 执行一次控制运行流程，可结合图像、模式和录制状态返回当前转向与油门。
schema.description_en: Execute one control cycle and return current steering and throttle, optionally considering image, mode, and recording state.

schema.description: 在线程化模式下返回当前转向与油门，并可应用默认模式或录制设置。
schema.description_en: Return current steering and throttle in threaded mode, optionally applying default mode or recording settings.
